newsitem.title: USA: Closing arguments postponed in Garcia Abrego trial.
newsitem.headline: Closing arguments postponed in Garcia Abrego trial.

text.p: Closing arguments in the trial of accused drug kingpin Juan Garcia Abrego were postponed for at least a day on Wednesday after the lead prosecutor in the case fell ill, a court spokeswoman said.
The arguments were rescheduled for Thursday, but the spokeswoman said they could be delayed further if prosecutor Melissa Annis had not recovered.
Garcia Abrego, once on the FBI's "10 Most Wanted" list, is accused of heading the Mexico-based Gulf drug cartel which at one time shipped up to a third of the cocaine consumed in the United States.
He was captured in Monterrey, Mexico, in January and flown to Houston for trial on 22 drug-related counts. Garcia Abrego, 52, faces life in prison if convicted.
